notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» takes prev1's names up to the first name the text writes itself (Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Maythami); prev1 has one route, so the inheritance is clear
«فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ» introduces a Qur'an remark, not a link; the Imam Abu Ja'far is inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator
